headline.text: 1 app build(s) and 2 automation(s) need a look.

workflows.name: 1. Manual Patch
workflows.purpose: Builds one app on request.

workflows.name: 10. Selection watch
workflows.purpose: Drops patch names providers stopped offering, lists new ones for you, digests provider releases.

workflows.name: 11. Rule merge
workflows.purpose: Rule merge: merges a Selection watch rule pull request only when every check, review and test build is green.

jobs.name: build (reddit) / Publish reddit
why: release contract: PUBLISH_REFUSED reddit: app 2026.40.0 is older than the published 2026.41.0; a phone cannot update to it and the shelf would show it as newest. Nothing was published.

workflows.name: 2. Check new patch
workflows.purpose: Checks the patch providers for new releases and builds the apps that changed (one full run a day and one quick check, both on schedule).

workflows.name: 3. Validate
workflows.purpose: Checks every change to the repository before it can be trusted.

workflows.name: 4. Explore patches
workflows.purpose: Lists the patch names a provider offers.

workflows.name: 5. Add target
workflows.purpose: Adds, changes, disables or removes an app; opens a pull request.

workflows.name: 6. Provider watch
workflows.purpose: Looks for new or changed patch releases.

workflows.name: 7. Nightly watch
workflows.purpose: One report on the repository and every provider.

workflows.name: 8. Community watch
workflows.purpose: Scans the community patch index for apps built here.

workflows.name: 9. Batch Patch
workflows.purpose: Builds several apps on request.

workflows.name: Council
workflows.purpose: Agent council: scheduled audits posted on the council desk issue.

jobs.name: Dependabot
why: Dependabot encountered an unexpected problem Error: fetching job details: missing response For more information see: https://github.com/govinda-rajulu/patch-factory/network/updates/1655959474 (write access to the repository is required to view the log)

workflows.name: Keepalive
workflows.purpose: Keeps scheduled automations from being paused by GitHub.

workflows.name: MCP scout
workflows.purpose: Manual only: finds unlisted community patch repositories for owner review.

workflows.name: Needs you
workflows.purpose: Combines the five standing watch reports into one plain-language Needs you issue.

workflows.name: Notify on failure
workflows.purpose: Runs inside Status page data: opens one issue per failing automation and closes it on the next success.

jobs.name: Agent review (required for onboarding)
why: ONBOARD_REVIEW_VERDICT: 3 of 6 counted verdicts say block

workflows.name: Onboarding review
workflows.purpose: Agent review of every new app, provider or patch name.

workflows.name: Qualify published shadow baselines
workflows.purpose: Qualifies the build evidence of published releases once the whole build run worked.

workflows.name: Repo setup
workflows.purpose: Applies the repository labels and files the planned feature requests once (runs when their files change).

workflows.name: Retention preview
workflows.purpose: Retention preview: reports shelf cleanup and applies only an owner-confirmed token.

workflows.name: Status page data
workflows.purpose: Writes the data for this page.

workflows.name: Tooling watch
workflows.purpose: Checks the pinned build tools for new versions, pre-releases included.

workflows.name: Weekly pin store check
workflows.purpose: Pin store check (weekly, report-only): reads whether exact store build pins are still listed, without downloading an APK.
